limitations: 模型照片与外观验证不证明固件兼容或实机通过；该SKU的独立数字运行支持和保留边界以产品目录及对应runtime验证回执为准。
未验证独立 PCB 布局/板级 CAD，保留可展开的 UNKNOWN 主板；外壳、纸贴、镜头与连接器分别着色。
原照片/丝印版权归 M5Stack，未确认独立开放图片许可；近似几何按项目许可，厂家 CAD 保留原 MIT。
本轮未进行浏览器 WebGL 正反斜视/三种材质真实渲染验收；资产加载、几何、UV、材质隔离与展开复位另做离线检查。
接口位置/插合深度和逐脚物理方位未独立标定，禁用可连接线缆；不能以近似插口当电气路由。
K115套件为ESP32-PICO-V3-02 Atom-PSRAM（8MB Flash/2MB PSRAM、CH9102）+GW1NR-9C FPGA+LT8618SX。不是C008 Atom Lite的4MB/noPSRAM配置。
固定M5_Hardware树未找到K115/AtomDisplay独立CAD或对应内嵌KiCad STEP；模型是该SKU照片和64×24×29mm标称包络约束的近似，隐藏卡扣/导轨/PCB厚度未知。
官方尺寸PDF另标总高28.7mm，产品规格取29mm；保留0.3mm差异，未按任一数值宣称制造精度。
模型照片与外观验证不证明固件兼容或实机通过；该SKU的独立数字运行支持和保留边界以产品目录及对应runtime验证回执为准。

2026-11-26 K115 photo2 is an open-cap board view; photo3 is the valid closed Atom-button cap view. The dark rectangle at negativeY is that physical cap, not a screen or the HDMI connector at positiveY, and is retained.

The unsupported open rear guide-ring is replaced by a solid photo-constrained2mm backplate with visible holes from exact photo4; placement and thickness remain estimates. Binary bytes are unchanged; former ring range remains retained but unused. Hidden latch, screw seating and optical/material parameters are not manufacturing CAD.

Atom-PSRAM front photo stays under the real detachable cap and follows the board. UNKNOWN remains on unmeasured internal/opposite board faces; backplate inspection exposes them. Product display:null and separate FPGA external-monitor runtime remain unchanged.
